name: Puget Sound Winter 2.0 2017
information:
**There is a 120 competitor limit and we ask that you please limit the number of guests that you bring.**

* We also ask that guests allow competitors to sit at the tables. All the information needed can be found on the other tabs
* While online registration is preferred, we will also take registration on site (cash only)

If you have any questions, please direct them to thecubedude101@gmail.com
